name: calculiva-home-improvement-constants
title: Calculiva home improvement constants register
description: The sourced trade constants loaded by the calculators on calculiva.com: nominal and actual board sizes, stock lengths, roll and bolt formats, panel modules, allowances and published estimating rules, each with its source, its verification date and its status. The CSV resource is the register and holds no value; the values are in the JSON resource. The calculators' editable default settings are not part of it.
rights: CC BY 4.0 covers Calculiva's own contribution only: the compilation, its structure, the statuses, the scopes and the notes. Third-party values (published charts, list prices, product dimensions, tool outputs) are attributed to their sources and dated; no right over them is granted or claimed. Third-party text is not reproduced: each record names the page it was read on, and the excerpts read stay in Calculiva's working files. Calculiva is not affiliated with any company named.

resources.name: register
resources.description: The register: one row per record, with its source, its dates and its status. It holds no value and no unit.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the record; also the key of the full record in the JSON file.

fields.name: status
fields.description: standard = taken from a published reference document cited by title and section; market_survey = read on products or tools on a stated date, always with an expiry date; convention = widely repeated, no normative source.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Where the values apply, and where they do not.

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: The document, product page or tool the values were read from.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: URL of that source. Empty when the publisher has removed the page since the reading; the JSON record then explains it in source_status.

fields.name: verified_at
fields.description: Date the source was last read (ISO 8601).

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: Date after which the record is left out of this dataset until its source is read again. Every market survey has one and a convention may have one; empty when the record does not expire.

fields.name: sample_size
fields.description: Number of products or executions observed, when the record is a survey.

resources.name: records
resources.description: Full records, values included. The keys beyond the register columns differ from one record to the next, because a lumber table and a wallpaper bolt chart do not share a shape.
